identificationModule.briefTitle: Cabazitaxel Versus Docetaxel Both With Prednisone in Patients With Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized, Open Label, Multi-Center Study Comparing Cabazitaxel at 25 mg/m^2 and at 20 mg/m^2 in Combination With Prednisone Every 3 Weeks to Docetaxel in Combination With Prednisone in Patients With Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer Not Pretreated With Chemotherapy

armGroups.label: Cabazitaxel 25 mg/m^2
armGroups.description: Cabazitaxel 25 mg/m\^2 intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle in combination with Prednisone 10 mg orally, once daily until disease progression (DP), unacceptable toxicity or participant's refusal.

armGroups.label: Cabazitaxel 20 mg/m^2
armGroups.description: Cabazitaxel 20 mg/m\^2 IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21 -day cycle in combination with Prednisone 10 mg orally, once daily until DP, unacceptable toxicity or participant's refusal.

armGroups.label: Docetaxel 75 mg/m^2
armGroups.description: Docetaxel (TXT) 75 mg/m\^2 IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle in combination with Prednisone 10 mg orally, once daily until DP, unacceptable toxicity or participant's refusal.
